security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, local output writes, and documented CLI examples. The only confirmed risks are OCR installation steps that use sudo apt-get, which require administrative privileges and can alter the host system. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: OCR documentation recommends sudo apt-get installation commands.
remediation.suggestion: Replace privileged install steps with confirmation-gated guidance, non-root alternatives, and links to official package documentation.

content.user_title: Process PDFs with Forms, Tables, and OCR
content.value_statement: Complex PDF workflows often need form analysis, table extraction, OCR, and repeatable validation. This skill provides practical local workflows and scripts for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code users.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to analyze PDF form fields with pypdf and the included analyze_form.py script.
Shows workflows for filling, validating, flattening, and batching PDF forms.
Documents table extraction with pdfplumber, CSV export, Excel export, and custom table settings.
Covers OCR workflows using pytesseract, pdf2image, image preprocessing, and language models.
Provides production patterns for error handling, logging, exit codes, and large-file processing.
limitations: Only analyze_form.py is present in this package; other named helper scripts are documented but not included.
OCR requires external Tesseract installation and appropriate language packages.
PDF extraction quality depends on document structure, scan quality, and table formatting.
The examples process local files and do not provide a hosted service or web interface.

use_cases.title: Automate Form Intake
use_cases.description: Extract field metadata, validate submission data, and prepare repeatable PDF form filling workflows.

use_cases.title: Extract Report Tables
use_cases.description: Turn tabular PDF reports into CSV or spreadsheet outputs for review and analysis.

use_cases.title: Recover Text From Scans
use_cases.description: Use OCR preprocessing and language settings to extract text from scanned documents.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a PDF Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to inspect my PDF form and explain the fields, required values, and suggested validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Tables From a Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to choose a table extraction approach for my report PDF and produce a clean CSV workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Plan OCR Processing
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design an OCR workflow for scanned PDFs, including preprocessing and language settings.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Batch Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a batch PDF pipeline with validation, logging, error handling, and safe output naming.

output_examples.input: A blank application PDF needs field discovery before automation.
output_examples.output: A field inventory with names, types, required status, default values, and recommended validation checks.

output_examples.input: A monthly PDF report contains tables across several pages.
output_examples.output: A table extraction plan that selects detection settings, merges repeated headers, and exports clean rows.

output_examples.input: A scanned contract needs searchable text extraction.
output_examples.output: An OCR workflow with image preprocessing, language selection, confidence checks, and text output handling.

best_practices: Validate source PDFs and input data before writing any output files.
Test extraction settings on sample pages before running large batches.
Keep original PDFs unchanged and write processed results to a separate output folder.
anti_patterns: Running privileged installation commands without user confirmation.
Assuming scanned PDFs will work with text extraction alone.
Processing large batches without logging, timeouts, or output validation.

faq.question: Does this skill include a working script?
faq.answer: Yes. The package includes scripts/analyze_form.py for PDF form field analysis.

faq.question: Can it fill PDF forms directly?
faq.answer: It documents form filling workflows, but the referenced fill_form.py script is not included in this package.

faq.question: Does OCR work without extra software?
faq.answer: No. OCR examples require Tesseract and Python packages such as pytesseract and pdf2image.

faq.question: Can it extract tables from every PDF?
faq.answer: No. Accuracy depends on table layout, page quality, and whether the PDF contains real text.

faq.question: Is this safe for sensitive documents?
faq.answer: The workflows are local, but users should control file paths and protect documents containing personal data.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
